Content: Relative payments of one polity to another (taxation, tribute,
reparations) should be based on reported numbers. So the paying polity
may underreport its capabilities and the receiving one may fund an
investigation to renew the numbers. How the authoritative number is
chosen should be part of the contract (reasonable consensus, payer or

receiver authoritative, average, neutral 3rd etc.).
So numbers
fudging could be an interesting game mechanic. Obviously it should be

automatable with a investigation budget and sliders.
The
payment-receiver now gains an interest in establishing a permanent
presence to update the data continiusly, while the payment-receiver
might be able to corrupt this census-bureaucrats.
